;;; -*- Mode: Lisp -*-
;;; Challenge-rescue experiment at the culture level: the top-level CRAM/RPL plan.
;;; Generated by rsa/culture_to_cram.py from rsa/registry/lab/culture_plan.ldl (LDL v0.3, culture level):
;;; 12 culture action designators, 13 causal links (7 physical, 6 knowledge),
;;; 13 order constraints, 6 action types. Below it: the lab level (rsa/out/challenge_rescue_src.lisp),
;;; whose action plans perform the lab action designators the culture actions are refined into.
;;; No plate, well, instrument or robot appears in code: vessels come from the mapping at run time.
;;; Notation: RPL control structures in CRAM Lisp syntax. Not executed: no Lisp CRAM here. ILLUSTRATIVE (D016).

(in-package :culture-src)   ; uses :lab-src
macros:
;;; The culture level adds this vocabulary to RPL/CRAM and to the lab level (package :lab-src):
;;; HOLDS, PREVENT, MAINTAIN, ENSURE, DEF-ACTION-PLAN and the lab action plans come from there.

(defmacro with-culture-contract ((self) &body refinement)
  "The clauses a culture action designator carries: wait for each requires-item a causal link
supplies, achieve the :establishable ones, perform the REFINEMENT, then add the PHYSICAL effects
to the belief state as projected (graded by the culture model until an observation bears on
them) and assert the KNOWLEDGE effects (records, images, estimates, the belief update) as known."
  `(seq (dolist (r (desig-prop-values ,self :requires))
          (if (establishable-p r) (achieve r) (wait-for (holds r))))
        ,@refinement
        (project-effects (desig-prop-values ,self :physical) :grade '(source projected))
        (assert-effects (desig-prop-values ,self :knowledge) :grade '(source recorded))))

(defmacro ensure-given (description)
  "A given-item: verified before the culture plan starts; a shortfall is treated by the
epistemic meta model like any ENSURE."
  `(ensure ,description :grade (source verified) :consequential t))

(defun vessel (culture)
  "The well that holds CULTURE, as chosen by the mapping to the laboratory (rsa/culture_plan.py)."
  (desig-prop-value (resolve-mapping culture) :vessel))
failures:
;;; Culture-level failures: violations of the culture plan's own policies. Lab failures (lab-failure
;;; and its subtypes) come from the lab action plans after their repairs ran out.

(define-condition culture-failure (plan-failure)
  ((designator :initarg :description :reader failure-designator))
  (:documentation "A violated prevents- or maintains-item of the culture plan."))
(define-condition control-exposed (culture-failure)
  ()
  (:documentation "The control culture received a substance: the comparison is no longer licensed."))
mapping:
(defparameter *culture-to-lab*
  ;; the refinement rsa/culture_plan.py resolved; the vessels are ?cr P17/A01; ?cc P17/A02; ?ck P17/A05
  '((vessels (?cr rescued ?r) (?cc comparator ?c) (?ck control ?k))
    (steps
      (c1 challenging -> intervening x1)
      (c2 challenging -> intervening x2)
      (g1 growing -> incubating w1)
      (c3 rescuing -> intervening x3)
      (g2 growing -> incubating w2)
      (o1 observing -> measuring m1)
      (o2 observing -> measuring m2)
      (o3 observing -> measuring m3)
      (i1 interpreting -> computation)
      (i2 interpreting -> computation)
      (i3 interpreting -> computation)
      (a1 analysing -> computation))))
action_plans:
(def-action-plan challenging ((culture ?culture) (substance ?substance) (dose ?dose) (at ?at))
  "Expose a culture to the challenge. Refined into one lab intervening action (a substance transfer).
Performed in: c1, c2."
  (with-culture-contract (?self)
    (perform (an action
                 (type intervening)
                 (into (vessel ?culture))
                 (substance ?substance)
                 (dose ?dose)
                 (at ?at)))))

(def-action-plan growing ((cultures ?cultures) (from ?from) (to ?to))
  "Let the cultures grow over a culture-time interval. Refined into one lab incubating action of their plate.
Performed in: g1, g2."
  (with-culture-contract (?self)
    (perform (an action
                 (type incubating)
                 (plate (plate-of ?cultures))
                 (in (environment-of ?cultures))
                 (from ?from)
                 (to ?to)))))

(def-action-plan rescuing ((culture ?culture) (substance ?substance) (dose ?dose) (at ?at))
  "Expose a challenged culture to the rescue. Refined into one lab intervening action.
Performed in: c3."
  (with-culture-contract (?self)
    (perform (an action
                 (type intervening)
                 (into (vessel ?culture))
                 (substance ?substance)
                 (dose ?dose)
                 (at ?at)))))

(def-action-plan observing ((culture ?culture) (readout ?readout) (at ?at))
  "Image a culture. Refined into one lab measuring action; its readout carries the raw image.
Performed in: o1, o2, o3."
  (with-culture-contract (?self)
    (perform (an action (type measuring) (of (vessel ?culture)) (readout organoid-radius) (at ?at)))))

(def-action-plan interpreting ((image ?image) (into ?into))
  "Turn an image into an organoid-radius estimate. A computation of the culture SDT; no lab action.
Performed in: i1, i2, i3."
  (with-culture-contract (?self)
    (perform (a computation (type image-analysis) (image ?image) (into ?into)))))

(def-action-plan analysing ((belief ?belief) (statistic ?statistic))
  "Update the belief over the recovery models from the radius difference. A computation; no lab action.
Performed in: a1."
  (with-culture-contract (?self)
    (perform (a computation (type model-posterior) (belief ?belief) (statistic ?statistic)))))
culture_plan:
(def-cram-function challenge-rescue-culture-plan (?cr ?cc ?ck ?ch ?rs ?B ?E)
  "The culture plan: 12 culture action designators. The order is derived from 13 causal links
over physical and knowledge effects (rsa/culture_plan.py); steps without an order between them
may run in any order or concurrently."
  ;; the images are knowledge: designators the observations make effective
  (let* ((?y1 (an image (of ?cr) (culture-time 72 h)))
         (?y2 (an image (of ?cc) (culture-time 72 h)))
         (?y3 (an image (of ?ck) (culture-time 72 h))))
    (partial-order
        ((:tag c1
           ;; challenging, culture-time 0 h
           (perform (an action
                        (type challenging)
                        (culture ?cr)
                        (substance ?ch)
                        (dose 0.85 au)
                        (at (culture-time 0 h))
                        (physical (the culture ?cr (exposed-to ?ch 0.85 au))
                                  (the culture ?cr (injury rising)))
                        (knowledge (a record (of c1) (states ?cr ?ch 0.85 au 0 h))))))
         (:tag c2
           ;; challenging, culture-time 0 h
           (perform (an action
                        (type challenging)
                        (culture ?cc)
                        (substance ?ch)
                        (dose 0.85 au)
                        (at (culture-time 0 h))
                        (physical (the culture ?cc (exposed-to ?ch 0.85 au))
                                  (the culture ?cc (injury rising)))
                        (knowledge (a record (of c2) (states ?cc ?ch 0.85 au 0 h))))))
         (:tag g1
           ;; growing, culture-time 0 h -> 48 h
           (perform (an action
                        (type growing)
                        (cultures ?cr ?cc ?ck)
                        (from (culture-time 0 h))
                        (to (culture-time 48 h))
                        (requires
                          (the culture ?cr (exposed-to ?ch))
                          (the culture ?cc (exposed-to ?ch)))
                        (physical (the experiment ?E (culture-time 48 h))
                                  (the culture ?cr (injury-burden accumulated)))
                        (knowledge (a record (of g1) (environment-history culture-standard))))))
         (:tag c3
           ;; rescuing, culture-time 48 h
           (perform (an action
                        (type rescuing)
                        (culture ?cr)
                        (substance ?rs)
                        (dose 0.70 au)
                        (at (culture-time 48 h))
                        (requires (the experiment ?E (culture-time 48 h)))
                        (physical (the culture ?cr (exposed-to ?rs 0.70 au))
                                  (the culture ?cr (recovery possible)))
                        (knowledge (a record (of c3) (states ?cr ?rs 0.70 au 48 h))))))
         (:tag g2
           ;; growing, culture-time 48 h -> 72 h
           (perform (an action
                        (type growing)
                        (cultures ?cr ?cc ?ck)
                        (from (culture-time 48 h))
                        (to (culture-time 72 h))
                        (requires (the culture ?cr (exposed-to ?rs)))
                        (physical (the experiment ?E (culture-time 72 h))
                                  (the culture ?cr (viability settled)))
                        (knowledge (a record (of g2) (environment-history culture-standard))))))
         (:tag o1
           ;; observing, culture-time 72 h
           (perform (an action
                        (type observing)
                        (culture ?cr)
                        (readout morphology)
                        (at (culture-time 72 h))
                        (requires (the experiment ?E (culture-time 72 h)))
                        (physical (the culture ?cr (light-dose increased)))
                        (knowledge (an image (of ?cr) (culture-time 72 h) (raw true))))))
         (:tag o2
           ;; observing, culture-time 72 h
           (perform (an action
                        (type observing)
                        (culture ?cc)
                        (readout morphology)
                        (at (culture-time 72 h))
                        (requires (the experiment ?E (culture-time 72 h)))
                        (physical (the culture ?cc (light-dose increased)))
                        (knowledge (an image (of ?cc) (culture-time 72 h) (raw true))))))
         (:tag o3
           ;; observing, culture-time 72 h
           (perform (an action
                        (type observing)
                        (culture ?ck)
                        (readout morphology)
                        (at (culture-time 72 h))
                        (requires (the experiment ?E (culture-time 72 h)))
                        (physical (the culture ?ck (light-dose increased)))
                        (knowledge (an image (of ?ck) (culture-time 72 h) (raw true))))))
         (:tag i1
           ;; interpreting, after its inputs
           (perform (an action
                        (type interpreting)
                        (image ?y1)
                        (into organoid-radius)
                        (requires
                          (an image (of ?cr) (raw true))
                          (a scale (of (an image)) (known true))
                          :establishable)
                        (knowledge (an estimate (of ?cr) (organoid-radius) (sigma 2.5 um))))))
         (:tag i2
           ;; interpreting, after its inputs
           (perform (an action
                        (type interpreting)
                        (image ?y2)
                        (into organoid-radius)
                        (requires
                          (an image (of ?cc) (raw true))
                          (a scale (of (an image)) (known true))
                          :establishable)
                        (knowledge (an estimate (of ?cc) (organoid-radius) (sigma 2.5 um))))))
         (:tag i3
           ;; interpreting, after its inputs
           (perform (an action
                        (type interpreting)
                        (image ?y3)
                        (into organoid-radius)
                        (requires
                          (an image (of ?ck) (raw true))
                          (a scale (of (an image)) (known true))
                          :establishable)
                        (knowledge (an estimate (of ?ck) (organoid-radius) (sigma 2.5 um))))))
         (:tag a1
           ;; analysing, after its inputs
           (perform (an action
                        (type analysing)
                        (belief ?B)
                        (statistic (difference (radius ?cr) (radius ?cc)))
                        (requires
                          (an estimate (of ?cr) (organoid-radius))
                          (an estimate (of ?cc) (organoid-radius))
                          (an estimate (of ?ck) (organoid-radius)))
                        (knowledge (the belief ?B (posterior updated))
                                   (the belief ?B (information-gain measured)))))))
      (:order c1 g1)  ; physical: (the culture ?cr (exposed-to ?ch))
      (:order c2 g1)  ; physical: (the culture ?cc (exposed-to ?ch))
      (:order g1 c3)  ; physical: (the experiment ?E (culture-time 48 h))
      (:order c3 g2)  ; physical: (the culture ?cr (exposed-to ?rs))
      (:order g2 o1)  ; physical: (the experiment ?E (culture-time 72 h))
      (:order g2 o2)  ; physical: (the experiment ?E (culture-time 72 h))
      (:order g2 o3)  ; physical: (the experiment ?E (culture-time 72 h))
      (:order o1 i1)  ; knowledge: (an image (of ?cr) (raw true))
      (:order o2 i2)  ; knowledge: (an image (of ?cc) (raw true))
      (:order o3 i3)  ; knowledge: (an image (of ?ck) (raw true))
      (:order i1 a1)  ; knowledge: (an estimate (of ?cr) (organoid-radius))
      (:order i2 a1)  ; knowledge: (an estimate (of ?cc) (organoid-radius))
      (:order i3 a1))))  ; knowledge: (an estimate (of ?ck) (organoid-radius))
top_level:
(def-top-level-cram-function challenge-rescue-culture-level ()
  "Question:
(which (a recovery-model (in (M1_graded M2_threshold M3_protective))) (explains (the rescue-efficacy (after (a delay (of 48 h)))))).
Goal: (the belief ?B (expected-information-gain (>= 0.5 bit))):
guaranteed in expectation by the design (0.5439 bit); one run measures its gain."
  ;; the process modules: the lab instruments (through the lab action plans) and the culture SDT for computations
  (with-process-modules-running (resolve-process-modules)
    (let* ((?E (current-experiment))
           (?cr (the culture (role rescued)))
           (?cc (the culture (role comparator)))
           (?ck (the culture (role control)))
           (?ch (some substance (type challenge)))
           (?rs (some substance (type rescue)))
           (?B (the belief (over (M1_graded M2_threshold M3_protective)) (prior uniform))))
      (with-failure-handling
          ((control-exposed (f)
             ;; the analysis would compare against an exposed control: do not update the belief
             (assert-effects '((the belief ?B (posterior withheld))) :grade '(source recorded))
             (escalate f))
           (lab-failure (f)
             ;; the lab action plans' repairs ran out; the culture plan cannot continue as derived
             (escalate f)))
        (unwind-protect
            (seq
              (ensure-given (the culture ?cr (state baseline)))
              (ensure-given (the culture ?cc (state baseline)))
              (ensure-given (the culture ?ck (state baseline)))
              (ensure-given (the belief ?B (entropy 1.585 bit)))
              (ensure-given (the experiment ?E (culture-time 0 h)))
              (ensure-design (the belief ?B (expected-information-gain (>= 0.5 bit))))
              (with-policy (par
                             (prevent (holds (an exposure (of ?ck) (to (some substance))))
                                      control-exposed)
                             (prevent (holds (an event (type contamination) (of (a culture))))
                                      contamination-suspected)
                             (maintain (holds (the culture ?cr (environment culture-standard)))
                                       environment-excursion)
                             (maintain (holds (the culture ?cc (environment culture-standard)))
                                       environment-excursion)
                             (maintain (holds (the culture ?ck (environment culture-standard)))
                                       environment-excursion))
                (challenge-rescue-culture-plan ?cr ?cc ?ck ?ch ?rs ?B ?E)))
          ;; the safe state on any exit, at the culture level: every culture in its environment
          (achieve (the culture ?cr (environment culture-standard)))
          (achieve (the culture ?cc (environment culture-standard)))
          (achieve (the culture ?ck (environment culture-standard))))))))
